tx:Label.text: The scores: the scorers below are the bar a served record must clear — one that falls short sends its learner back to learn again while the binding keeps serving — and the judges of every candidate a session learns. The gate here decides whether what was learned becomes a binding.

form:FormGroup.label: Promotion mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: Automatic: a candidate that passes the gate goes live. Review: it is appended as a draft binding that serves nothing, and the streams of its learner wait until a person approves it.

form:FormGroup.label: Promotion floor (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The weighted score a candidate must reach on the held-out sample before it can be promoted. It must also not regress against the incumbent on any previously accepted record.

form:FormGroup.label: Held-out fraction (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The share of a stream's records withheld from the model and used only to judge promotion.

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum records to learn
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many records a stream must bring before its learner learns from it, and before promotion is judged; below this a candidate that clears the floor is bound provisionally and waits for more.

form:FormGroup.label: Regression records per binding
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most previously accepted records retained per binding for the regression check.

form:FormGroup.label: Regression retention (days)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Not yet applied: regression records are kept on the source feed and follow its retention.

form:FormGroup.label: Flag a serving binding below (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: A binding whose rolling per-record score falls below this is flagged in the Supervisor's serving list. It goes on serving; a record that falls short of the bar is what sends its learner back to learn again.
